messages:
Ana: Quick heads-up: AcmeEdge marketplace listing needs final compliance bundle. We need SOC2, pen test (redacted), questionnaire, vuln CSV. Who will own presign uploads?

Simon: I can own orchestration. timeline? :calendar:

Ana: Partner wants to drop artifacts by EOD Wed so we can review Thurs. Need presigns, redaction guidance, named owners for each artifact type.

Marie: Security will do redaction QA. Expected deliverables: redacted SOC2 PDF, redacted/full pen executive summary (pen full under NDA), vuln-scan.csv, completed partner_questionnaire.pdf.

Kevin-SI: (from AcmeEdge) we can provide the full pen report but require NDA before sharing. Also please confirm presign paths and expiry.

Simon: Presign pattern: s3://redwood-marketplace-evidence/partners/acmeedge/<artifact-type>/<filename>. We'll create a partner-scoped prefix and post PM-only presign links.

Julia: Default presign TTL is 72h. For sensitive artifacts (pen, SOC) we prefer 24h. Want checksums uploaded alongside files (md5 or sha256).

Marie: 24h TTL accepted for pen and SOC. Require an accompanying .md5 file for each upload and a redaction_manifest.csv listing removed pages/values. Manifest format: artifact,original_location,redaction_reason. Example: acme_pen.pdf,page_12,api_key_removal

Ana: Can someone draft a short partner checklist with exact filenames and manifest template? I'll send to partner once agreed.

Simon: I'll draft checklist. Quick operational Q: who signs off redactions prior to acceptance?

Marie: Security signs off redaction. Partner should upload both the redacted artifact and the redaction_manifest.csv. Security will review and either accept or request revisions.

Kevin-SI: We'll handle initial redaction but need the manifest template and a sample redacted doc to match formatting. Also need NDA contact.

Simon: Legal contact: legal-marketplace@redwood.com. I'll loop Legal immediately and request an NDA template.

Kevin-SI: Thanks. Also, pen vendor performs their own redaction; confirm if we still need internal redaction manifest post-vendor redaction.

Marie: Yes — vendor-redacted file is fine, but partner must provide a manifest describing any redactions vendor performed. We need transparency for audit.

Julia: Example presign command for partner (24h expiry = 86400s):
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-marketplace-evidence/partners/acmeedge/pen/acme_pen_redacted.pdf --expires-in 86400
```

Simon: Timeline recap: partner uploads Wed EOD, security reviews Thu, legal signs NDA asap, final go/no-go Thu evening. Publish listing next week if cleared.

Ana: @Simon can you take final go/no-go? I'll handle partner comms and timeline.

Simon: Yup. Owners list: SOC -> Marie, Pen -> Marie + Security Ops, NDA -> Legal, Presign + uploads -> Julia, Final go/no-go -> Simon.

Kevin-SI: Request: can you drop a redacted mock sample into the partner prefix so our vendor sees the expected format? Saves review cycles.

Marie: I'll upload a mock redacted pen sample and manifest to the partner prefix within 1h.

ops-bot: Created S3 prefix "partners/acmeedge-1723332100/" and generated 4 presigned URLs (pen, soc, vuln-csv, questionnaire) expiring in 86400s. Links posted to PM only.

Kevin-SI: Got the PM links, starting uploads now. We'll include .md5 checksum files.

Ana: Thanks team — keeping this thread as the single source of truth for evidence handoff. I'll post any blockers here. :thumbsup:
